name: Giant Crocodile

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The crocodile can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The crocodile makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) and the Restrained condition until the grapple ends, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature that isn't Grappled by the crocodile, it is pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

description: Giant crocodiles lurk motionless below the surface of rivers and swamps, ancient predators that clamp down on prey and drag it beneath the water to drown.
